<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.10"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="27" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">9:41</text>
    <line x1="320" y1="22" x2="320" y2="27" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="325" y1="19" x2="325" y2="27" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="16" x2="330" y2="27" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M341 22 C345 18 351 18 355 22" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M343 25 C346 22 350 22 353 25" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="28" r="1.5" fill="#050505"/>
    <rect x="363" y="17" width="22" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="19" width="16" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#050505"/>
    <rect x="386" y="20" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#050505"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="30,64 22,72 30,80" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="48" y="78" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">Profile setup</text>
    <text x="24" y="111" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">Complete your profile to personalize your news feed.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Completion indicator -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="130" width="342" height="6" rx="3" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
    <rect x="24" y="130" width="205" height="6" rx="3" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="334" y="153" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">60%</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Profile image -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <circle cx="195" cy="226" r="70" fill="#DDEBFC"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="205" r="23" fill="#1877F2" opacity="0.85"/>
    <ellipse cx="195" cy="252" rx="43" ry="28" fill="#1877F2" opacity="0.85"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="247" cy="274" r="20" fill="#1877F2" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="240" y1="281" x2="253" y2="268" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="239" y1="284" x2="243" y2="283" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="252" y1="267" x2="255" y2="270" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="316" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Change photo</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Form fields -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="350" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">Username</text>
    <rect x="24" y="359" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="36" y="390" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">@alexmorgan</text>

    <text x="24" y="433" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">Full name</text>
    <rect x="24" y="442" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="36" y="473" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">Alex Morgan</text>

    <text x="24" y="516" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">Email address</text>
    <rect x="24" y="525" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="36" y="556" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">alex.morgan@email.com</text>

    <text x="24" y="599" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">Phone number</text>
    <rect x="24" y="608" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="36" y="639" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">+1 (415) 555-0186</text>
    <text x="24" y="676" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#A0A3BD">Your details are private and will not be shared publicly.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom action -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="695" width="342" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="695" width="342" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="195" y="727" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#FFFFFF">Next</text>
    <polyline points="220,719 226,725 220,731" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="776" width="390" height="68" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="776" x2="390" y2="776" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Explore -->
    <circle cx="58" cy="798" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="61,795 58,802 54,799" fill="#667080"/>
    <text x="58" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#667080">Explore</text>
    <!-- Bookmarks -->
    <polyline points="141,791 141,807 147,803 153,807 153,791" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="147" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#667080">Saved</text>
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="220,797 229,790 238,797" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="223" y="797" width="12" height="10" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="229" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#667080">Home</text>
    <!-- Profile active -->
    <circle cx="320" cy="795" r="5" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <ellipse cx="320" cy="805" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="320" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
